chunks: Everything in it that is from Isma'il ibn Rabah, I have narrated from Muhammad ibn 'Ali Majilawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from his father, from Ahmad ibn Abi 'Abdillah al-Barqi, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Isma'il ibn Rabah al-Kufi.

key_terms.إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ الْكُوفِيِّ: A Kufan transmitter from whom these reports are narrated.
key_terms.الْبَرْقِيِّ: A reference to the al-Barqi transmitter family within the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the compiler's mode of narration.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ: A major transmitter named in the chain of narration.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from Isma'il ibn Rabah in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Isma'il ibn Rabah al-Kufi. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission, which is essential in hadith sciences for identifying how a narration reaches the compiler.
